items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: See, because Willie Jackson, who was a singer, Willie Jackson and Nookie, they used to play at a place at the Candlelight in Chicago -- I mean in New Orleans, and he'd give me steps the way the chorus girls was going to kick and go on.

ctx.x: See, because Willie Jackson, who was a singer, Willie Jackson and Nookie, they used to play at a place at the Candlelight in Chicago -- I mean in New Orleans, and he'd give me steps the way the chorus girls was going to kick and go on. When he found out I was going into the Lyric Theatre. I'm going to give you an idea, Zutty, how the gals go and dance, and everything, and you --
You were sort of accents that naturally got to coincide with theirs.
